name: ceo-tui
description: A team of AI agents that work with each other, on Claude, Codex and Gemini, from one terminal: hire, budget, delegate, audit, with a hash-chained ledger of every run, note and dollar.
author: Sumer Vaid <sumer@stanford.edu> (https://github.com/sumervaid)

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.demo:chat: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh chat && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/chat.tape'
scripts.demo:live: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh team && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/live.tape'
scripts.demo:collab: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh org && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/collab.tape'
scripts.demo:all: pnpm demo && pnpm demo:company && pnpm demo:chat && pnpm demo:live && pnpm demo:suggest && pnpm demo:queue && pnpm demo:setup && pnpm demo:collab && pnpm demo:docket && pnpm demo:integrations && pnpm demo:sky && pnpm demo:evidence
scripts.demo:docket: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh team && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/docket.tape'
scripts.demo:sky: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh sky && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/sky.tape'
scripts.demo:evidence: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh evidence && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/evidence.tape'
scripts.demo:integrations: tools/demo/fixture.sh >/dev/null && tools/demo/fixture.sh team && bash -c 'eval "$(tools/demo/fixture.sh env)" && vhs tools/demo/integrations.tape'
